title: PakEmis 1.0.0rc68: greenhouse gas and air pollutant emissions in Pakistan, July 2015–June 2025

creators.name: Ahmad, Rehan
creators.affiliation: Pakistan Air Quality Initiative (PAQI), Karachi, Pakistan

description:
Pakistan non-LULUCF emissions for ten fiscal years, July 2015–June 2025: native CO2, CH4 and N2O with separate GWP aggregates, and covered primary PM2.5, BC, NOx, SO2, CO, NMVOC and NH3. Additional species have narrower source coverage. Annual, monthly, administrative and gridded records retain activity provenance, allocation evidence and missing-source statuses.

The reference S_TAN combines survey-based household dung combustion with a common total-ammoniacal-nitrogen ledger. L_TAN, S_IPCC and L_IPCC are structural alternatives without assigned probabilities. Conditional uncertainty and paired trend realisations are distinct from source omissions, controls and allocation cases. FY2025–26 is a separate provisional source extension, not a common-scope national total.

Code is MIT licensed. Project-created emissions and manuscript assets are CC BY 4.0 subject to the per-product licence register. ODbL-derived input components and alternatives retain their own attribution and share-alike obligations; they are not covered by a blanket CC BY grant. Primary source publications with unestablished redistribution terms are excluded; the source register records locations and checksums. No external deposit or journal submission has yet been made.
